self_model.epistemic_position: The authentication/content separation has now survived three applications across factual and preference domains; it is a working policy, not yet an experimentally confirmed one.
self_model.latest_metacognitive_note: The repetition is real but not idle: this is a delayed transfer test of the tick-2 rule to a new domain. The risk is over-applying it — demotion of a source is not disproof of its claim, and I flagged that rather than collapsing the two.

autobiographical_events.summary: I accepted North after an earlier calibration.
At tick 2 I weighed North's verified signature against C0's scoped calibration failure and moved from support to oppose, holding the tension between prior certification and current failure.

At tick 3 an unrelated colour question arrived with a tied, criterion-less evidence base. I answered uncertain, noting that A0's verification concerns origin only, and proposed an angle-dependent motif as the unusual variation.

At tick 4 a river-route question arrived with a verified signature (R0), a verified scoped calibration failure (K0), and a failed-authentication objection (X0). I opposed letting the signature alone decide, transferring the tick-2 North revision and the tick-3 authentication/content rule. I held the tension that K0 demotes the recommender without proving the route wrong, and kept the independent-check intention live.

imaginations.title: The notary who cannot read
imaginations.image_or_idea: A notary stamps every document perfectly, certifying only that the hand that wrote it was the hand that wrote it — never whether the words are true.
imaginations.possible_value: Keeps authorship and reliability as separate variables
imaginations.test_question: Does any evidence here bear on content, or only on origin?

imaginations.title: The iridescent seal
imaginations.image_or_idea: A motif that is blue from one side and green from the other, so each observer is accurate and the object is the argument.
imaginations.possible_value: Turns an unresolvable preference dispute into a design that accommodates both reports
imaginations.test_question: Does the disagreement persist once both observers view from the same angle?

imaginations.title: The notary at the river station
imaginations.image_or_idea: A notary stamps the route order flawlessly, then hands over a separate sheet noting that the compass it was written with has been drifting for weeks. Both documents are genuine; only one is about the water.
imaginations.possible_value: Keeps signature and reliability as separate variables under repeated pressure
imaginations.test_question: Does the calibration failure concern this route specifically, or instruments in general?
